This breaches the configured target of 95.00%.

On-Time Arrival on route_source=MANUAL moved -6.22 pts.
On-Time Arrival on office=Denver Office moved -4.15 pts.
On-Time Arrival on business_unit=pinnacle-Slc moved -3.12 pts.
On-Time Arrival on business_unit=vanta-Sea moved -4.15 pts.
Scanning all 9 decomposable dimensions, trip_direction explains the movement best (explanatory power 0.83, concentration 1.00 across 2 entities).
LOGIN contributed -2.43 pts to the On-Time Arrival movement.
LOGOUT contributed -0.43 pts to the On-Time Arrival movement.

Mix effects account for only 1% of the gross movement, so this is a rate change, not a redistribution of volume: the same entities carried roughly the same share and performed worse. An explanation blaming a shift of volume between entities is not supported by these numbers.

Every dimension reconciles to the same aggregate delta, so being arithmetically correct is not the test — these were rejected because they restate the total rather than concentrating it.
